references.text: The Amalekites and Canaanites are mentioned as those who live in the valley, which explains the threat in verse 43
Fulfillment of the warning: The Amalekites and Canaanites struck down the Israelites
Moses repeats the Lord's warning that He would not go with them into battle
The Amorites struck down the Israelites because the Lord was not with them
The Lord says He will no longer be with Israel due to sin, the same principle as in Num 14:43
Earlier battle against the Amalekites, where victory came when the Lord was with Israel
Turning away from the Lord leads to defeat by enemies, parallel to the consequences in Num 14:43
Samson did not know that the Lord had left him, illustrating the consequence of the Lord not being with them
